Second infant: in the same year, on the twelfth day of July, in the same church, the same priest baptised an infant named Filemena with all the rites of the Sacrament.

Second: daughter of Iosikota and Agota, née Karkovna, Lavrinikov, lawfully married peasants, born on 12 July 1869 in the town of Plungė of this parish.
en.godparents: First: the godparents were Lavrenti Gymenkos and Petronela Tumovna, a maiden. Second: the godparents were Martin Varnems and Domicela Markovna, a maiden.

issues.en: Two entries run together in one row (Veronika and Filemena). Father of the second child 'Iosikota' is garbled. Both godparent lines are partly garbled; the second baptism says 'Таинста' (garbled).
issues.lt: Eilutėje du įrašai. Antrojo įrašo tėvo vardas perskaitytas „Іосикота“, pavardė „Лаврииковъ“; pirmojo krikštatėvio vardas ir pavardė („Лавнентіи Гымен косъ“) neaiškūs; paraštėje pavardžių nėra.
